items.source: By default, JSON mapping uses default typing. Make sure to configure an appropriate PolymorphicTypeValidator to prevent instantiation of unwanted types.
items.translation: 默认情况下，JSON 映射使用默认类型。请确保配置适当的 `PolymorphicTypeValidator`，以防止实例化不需要的类型。

items.source:
Flattening requires all property names to not interfere with JSON paths. Using dots or brackets in map keys or as
property names is not supported using flattening. The resulting hash cannot be mapped back into an Object.
items.translation: 扁平化要求所有属性名称不得与 JSON 路径冲突。在映射键或属性名称中使用点号或方括号不受扁平化支持。生成的哈希无法映射回对象。

items.source: ObjectMapper based HashMapper implementation that allows flattening. Given an entity Person with an Address like below the flattening will create individual hash entries for all nested properties and resolve complex types into simple types, as far as possible.
items.translation: 基于 ObjectMapper 的 HashMapper 实现，支持扁平化操作。给定一个包含如下 Address 属性的实体 Person，扁平化过程将为所有嵌套属性创建独立的哈希条目，并在可能的情况下将复杂类型解析为简单类型。

items.source:
Example

class Person {
        String firstname;
        String lastname;
        Address address;
        Date date;
        LocalDateTime localDateTime;
}

class Address {
        String city;
        String country;
}

Normal
items.translation:
示例

class Person {
    String firstname;
    String lastname;
    Address address;
    Date date;
    LocalDateTime localDateTime;
}

class Address {
    String city;
    String country;
}

普通

items.source: Flat
items.translation: 扁平化
